blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Gokongwei-backed GoTyme Bank has raised its year-end customer target to 12.5 million from 12 million, as monthly customer additions surged to 450,000-500,000, nearly doubling from its previous pace. Speaking at the Economic Journalists Association of the Philippines infrastructure forum, GoTyme CEO Nate Clarke said the digital bank currently has about 11.5 million customers.
